name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
lede: Three games, 37.0 points a night on 56 percent shooting, capped by 40 to rally the Thunder past the Pelicans.
dek: 37.0 a night this week, and the hard stop that gets him his pull-up.

move.title: The hard-stop pull-up
move.text: He attacks downhill at full speed so his defender has to backpedal, then slams on the brakes. The defender keeps drifting back, and Gilgeous-Alexander rises into the gap for the pull-up. The Ringer calls it “slamming his brakes to create an exaggerated window of separation.”
steps: Full speed at the rim, so the defender backpedals.
One hard stop, lead foot out front. The defender keeps going.
Up into the gap before he can close it.
